da7fb2860ebaa58725626463c425b2d5cecb7a0a:
fragment EventFields on Event {
  id
  name
  slug
  description
  location
  eventStartTime
  eventEndTime
  registrationStartTime
  registrationEndTime
  isHighlighted
  isDraft
  headerImageFile
  openQuotaSize
  paymentMode
  signupOpen
  signupUpcoming
  signupClosed
  createdBy
  updatedBy
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  __typename
}
mutation CreateEvent($input: CreateEventInput!) {
  createEvent(input: $input) {
    event {
      ...EventFields
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
